thread:
Sam (AE): Quick sync — NovaCare wants to kick off the POC but their procurement team insists on an original wet-ink Order Form. They said their internal audit requires it. Blocking our onboarding.

Riley (Procurement): Do they allow a notarized scan as interim? Sometimes compliance will accept that with the original mailed later. Need their PO to route invoices.

Sam (AE): PO is NC-2024-556. They also flagged pricing: want a one-time POC credit applied to the first month invoice. Is that OK?

Avery (Legal): Pricing credit is fine if we document it on the Order Form or an addendum. For the wet-ink issue, propose hybrid approach: countersign via DocuSign now for our records, accept notarized scanned copy for invoice/payment, and request original mailed within 7 business days. Add attestation clause to Order Form such as:

``
A scanned or photocopied copy, including a notarized scan, of a manually executed Order Form shall be deemed an original for purposes of contract formation and invoicing.
``

Also ensure DPA reference is present: "Data processing governed by Exhibit C (DPA) attached hereto."

Riley (Procurement): Customer said Policy 7.2 requires originals for vendors with contracts >$75k. POC spend is <$75k, but they won't budge. They will accept notarized scan if original is mailed to:

NovaCare Legal Dept
Attn: Contracts Intake
10 Market St, Suite 200
Boston, MA 02108

Sam (AE): Uploaded revised Order Form with credit line: https://secure.redwood.company/attachments/novacare-poc-orderform-v3.pdf and SOC2 link: https://secure.redwood.company/soc2/redwood-novacare-2025?token=REDACTED (expires 21 days).

SignBot: Envelope env_2c4f created. Recipients: NovaCare Contracts, Sam (AE), Avery (Legal). Status: sent.

Avery (Legal): Two additional notes: (1) add a one-sentence invoice remittance address block so Finance can match payments; (2) clarify that the POC credit is applied as a one-time reduction to the first invoice and cannot be carried forward. I'll add both items as an addendum in the envelope.

Morgan (Finance): We need the PO number NC-2024-556 and the remittance address. If we get the notarized scan + PO, Finance will issue invoice Net30. If customer requests Net45, we need approval from Revenue Ops.

Riley (Procurement): I'll confirm with the customer that notarized scan + original mailed within 7 business days is acceptable. If they insist on originals only, escalate to their Security Lead.

Sam (AE): I'll request the notarized scan and tracking number, and will attach the scanned copy here once received. Will update the thread when DocuSign completes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
__note: Slack thread as a single continuous string per agents.md; no title field included.
